test_posemb_sincos_1d: test the posemb_sincos_1d function to generate 1D sine-cosine positional embeddings for a sequence of given length and width
test_posemb_sincos_2d: test the posemb_sincos_2d function to generate 2D sine-cosine positional embeddings for a grid of height and width
test_posemb_sincos_3d: test the posemb_sincos_3d function to generate 3D sine-cosine positional embeddings for a volume of depth, height, and width
